card.name: Letter p or P starting a split word
card.fires_on: A lone p or P that begins the second half of a word after a slash, hyphen or joined word, as in ILD/pneumonitis, Hallucinations/Psychosis, counterpulsation and APPLY-PNH.

modes.label: After a slash
modes.description: The letter p or P opens pneumonitis or psychosis right after a slash or a joined heading.

modes.label: Inside a compound
modes.description: The letter p stands alone partway through a longer compound term or trial name.
